purpose: Navigation and evidence policy; measured counts are produced by the commands below.

measuredLedger.policy: A stage is passed only by executed evidence for that exact producer revision and environment. Parser acceptance does not promote later stages. Untested stages remain untested.

historicalLedger.status: historical; includes obsolete schema and missing-capability assertions

learningImprovement: Requires a separately executed frozen base-versus-trained experiment.
generate: npm run coverage:current -- --out PATH [--megatoken DIR --tokenizer FILE --python PYTHON]
baseline: npm run baseline:v5 -- --out DIRECTORY [--megatoken DIR --tokenizer FILE --python PYTHON]
historicalScope: Original synchronous semantic-execution/1 ledger, retained byte-for-byte; not current capability evidence.
interpretation: Retained reports state the exact revisions they measured and are not qualification of a later containing commit. Native qualification of separate corpora does not fill a feature-level native column. Model results require actual evaluation. No full ECMAScript or Test262 claim.
